name: Cellular & Molecular Neuroscience
summary: The detailed biophysics and molecular biology of neurons: ion channels, action potentials, synapses and the mechanisms of plasticity.

topics.name: Neuronal cell biology: axonal transport, polarity and dendritic structure
Ion channel structure, gating and diversity
Hodgkin-Huxley analysis of the action potential
Myelination, saltatory conduction and cable theory
Presynaptic mechanisms: vesicle cycle, calcium and quantal release
Ionotropic receptors: glutamate, GABA, glycine and nicotinic receptors
Metabotropic receptors and neuromodulation (dopamine, serotonin, noradrenaline, acetylcholine)
Long-term potentiation and depression: NMDA receptors and AMPA trafficking
